title: Exactly Protocol — Peripheral Contract Access Control Vulnerability Analysis
loss_raw: ~$7,300,000 (4,323.6 ETH; confirmed by The Block, Olympix, Neptune Mutual — no significant recovery occurred; the $12.85M early estimate was revised down to $7.3M in official post-mortem)
root_cause: DebtManager `leverage()` — permit signature bypass and arbitrary `_msgSender` impersonation via a fake market contract
steps: 1. leverage(FakeMarket[i], 0, 0, 0, Permit{account: victim[i], v:0, r:0, s:0})
3. Only consumes nonce with no signature check → passes ✓
6. Supplies only FakeToken to FakeToken-USDC Uni-V3 pool
→ executes in victim[i]'s name because _msgSender = victim[i]
10. UNIV3NFTManager.collect() → sends recovered USDC to attacker (Owner)
11. Deposit 90% of USDC balance into exaUSDC (acquire shares)
